- **Setup and build:** Look for good intonation, low and even action, no fret buzz, smooth fret ends, and solid hardware and finish.
- **Budget:** American-made Les Pauls typically start around $1,000–$1,500.

**Testing tip:** Bring your own cable, and if possible a pick and your usual amp settings. Compare it directly against your Strat. Try several examples of the same model, since individual guitars vary a lot.
